cues.text: And right now, for most organizations, that context is scattered, living across wikis, spreadsheets, and the heads of three people on your data team.
Same term gets defined differently across teams, and when your agents give you a confident answer, you have no way to know if it's based on validated definitions or noise.
Databricks is solving this with Genie Ontology, a continuously learned enterprise context layer that Genie draws from to ground every answer it gives.
